messages:
Alex Li: Quick heads-up — we're kicking off an eval of PriceBridge for invoice reconciliation + TCO reporting. They sent a short deck and API docs. Can folks skim?
Maria Ortega: On it. main things we need: line-item matching accuracy, ability to ingest PDFs + CSVs, and exportable normalized usage records.
Jordan Park: Also need pricing model clarity. Seat vs usage, commit tiers, overage calc, and how credits are applied. Can we get a sample invoice mapping?
Alex Li: They included a sample payload but it's missing VAT handling and multi-currency examples. I'll ask for mappings.
Sasha Kim: Security questions: SSO/SCIM, audit log retention, ability to host in our VPC or ship via secure SFTP. Any SOC2 or ISO certs?
ProcureBot: FYI — vendor questionnaire (security/compliance) is due by EOD Friday for the RFP shortlist.
Jordan Park: Can someone confirm integration points? We want realtime usage export to our GCS/S3 bucket and a webhook for reconciliation failures. If they only offer batch S3 pulls every 24h that's a no-go for a few teams.
Maria Ortega: PriceBridge docs mention a streaming API and an S3 export. Need to confirm SLA on delivery and backfill window. I'll flag that to them.
Alex Li: Budget note: finance prefers commit + discount for predictable spend. Can Procurement negotiate a 12mo commit with quarterly true-ups?
Jordan Park: Yes — procurement should push for a Q1 pilot (no commit) then convert to a 12mo with a 10-15% discount if usage stays within X% of forecast.
Sasha Kim: Legal will want data residency clause for EU customers and a clause about deletion on contract termination. Add that to the security questionnaire.
Alex Li: I'll reply to the vendor asking for: 1) sample invoice JSONs including VAT + multi-currency, 2) confirmation of SSO/SCIM & SCIM provisioning docs, 3) streaming API vs daily export, 4) SOC2/ISO certs and data residency options, 5) pricing matrix (seat vs usage vs hybrid) with commit tiers.
Maria Ortega: Tagging Jordan for pricing negotiation lead. Jordan, can you take lead on getting the pricing spreadsheet and model the TCO for our 6-month pilot?
Jordan Park: Yep — I'll draft the model. Need their unit definitions (what counts as a 'seat' vs a 'processing unit') and any hidden extra fees (onboarding, ingestion, connectors).
ProcureBot: Note — include procurement@redwood.com and legal@redwood.com on all replies to lock in vendor NDA terms.
Alex Li: Perfect. I'll send the clarification email now and ping here when they respond. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Maria Ortega: Thanks — please drop any vendor docs into #vendors-drive-uploads so we can centralize.
Jordan Park: Will do.
Sasha Kim: If they send a demo, include security for a short pre-demo checklist. I can join that call.
Alex Li: Demo requested. Tentative next steps: vendor reply by Thu, price spreadsheet by Fri, security questionnaire + certs by EOD Fri.
ProcureBot: Reminder: add the vendor to the RFP tracking sheet (ID PB-2026-03).
